head: codex/sentinel-proof-history-20261011
title: fix(kpmo): bind latest native Sentinel within archived history
body:
The second natural Assurance generation fails because its authenticated whole-platform proof retains multiple Sentinel archive tuples while the observation consumer requires exactly one. Gate 38069855958 reproduced this with three rows; the verified archive SHA256 is 1cc17355e976b39229206f4db604670562ee41d74a6a696df9474afed64963e9.

Preserve all history, validate every Sentinel row and reject duplicate run/artifact bindings, then consume only the tuple selected from the authenticated native observation window. The Gate collects continuation evidence before initial selection; the causal workflow_run route remains unchanged. Manual dispatch does not become natural evidence.

Validation: 45 targeted regression/negative tests pass. The actual failed archive now resolves EXTERNAL_CLOCK_PROOF_BOUND to native Sentinel 38069498104, artifact 11675732702, digest sha256:f1eff0ffcf258d9e1b0abd5889b9c7324184e53ab952da1be57295759660d3c1. Independent holistic Red Team review found no additional blocker in this correction; exact-head remote validation and protected landing remain required.

Scope: four source files plus immutable proposal metadata; rollback reverts this correction. No provider activation, broker deploy, UNKNOWN retry, credential change or Production/Public/G5 promotion. Historical failed runs remain failed. This proposal grants no landing authority. Downstream external-clock chain collection, protected UNKNOWN reconciliation, native reservation/finalizer proof and PSA lawful inputs/runtime remain separate unmet conditions.

Evidence: https://github.com/johnkim9524-collab/kaios_enterprise_repo/actions/runs/38069855958
Autobalance wait correction is reused via PR #2646; no duplicate proposal.
